Grill

What comes off the grill

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Souvlaki

Pork souvlaki and chicken thighs grilled with onions and peppers, on the plate or in a Cypriot pita.

Sheftalia

Guests call the sheftalia the best in town, as a portion or in a pita.

Pork chop and liver

A juicy pork chop, beef liver, grilled halloumi and mushrooms, with homemade fries.

For parties

Take away, delivery and catering, with special prices for large party orders.

From the grill

Photos from the Google listing.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

A local place

Simple and traditional, a family business where guests feel welcome. Locals know where to eat well, one writes.

Quick and friendly

Guests write about fast service with a smile, and a takeaway ready within 15 minutes.

Book on busy nights

On busy evenings it fills up, guests advise booking a table.

In Strovolos

At Andrea Avraamidi 48A in Strovolos. Open Monday to Saturday at lunchtime and in the evening.

What guests say

Three of 186 Google reviews, 151 of them with five stars.

“A local experience. They use simple, fresh and good ingredients. Their pork chop might be the best i have tried in my life”

Google review
“Great Cypriot kebabs served with a smile. Very efficient and attentive staff. Their sheftalia mixed is THE BEST!! Simple tavern and take away - and great simple food. V reasonable.”

Google review
“This place is not for tourists. Locals know where to eat well with perfect service. Very tasty, very fast service, good pricing. Cold glasses for beer, juicy pork chops, fresh vegetables. Yammy. You will not find an available spot if you come late after 9. This place is not about views and fancy interiors. It's about feeling welcome.”
